faces.name: Know Evil
faces.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, until your next turn, up to one target opponent can't attack with creatures, up to one target opponent can't cast creature spells, and up to one target opponent can't cast noncreature spells. You can't choose any player as a target more than once.

faces.name: Half the Battle
faces.oracleText: Search your library for a Battle card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

faces.name: Knowledge and Power
faces.oracleText: Whenever you scry, you may pay {2}. If you do, this enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.

faces.name: Knowledge Exploitation
faces.oracleText:
Prowl {3}{U} (You may cast this for its prowl cost if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with a Rogue.)
Search target opponent's library for an instant or sorcery card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then that player shuffles.

faces.name: Knowledge Is Power
faces.oracleText: Creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn.

faces.name: Knowledge Pool
faces.oracleText:
Imprint — When this artifact enters, each player exiles the top three cards of their library.
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, that player exiles it. If the player does, they may cast a spell from among other cards exiled with this artifact without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: Knowledge Seeker
faces.oracleText:
Vigilance
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
When this creature dies, create a Clue token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

faces.name: Knowledge Vault
faces.oracleText:
{2}, {T}: Exile the top card of your library face down.
{0}: Sacrifice this artifact. If you do, discard your hand, then put all cards exiled with this artifact into their owner's hand.
When this artifact leaves the battlefield, put all cards exiled with it into their owner's graveyard.
